simple.meaning: חַשְׁמַל (chashmal) is a Hebrew word meaning “probably bronze or polished spectrum metal.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חַשְׁמַל (H2830) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezekiel 1:4, with occurrences in Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חַשְׁמַל (H2830) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חַשְׁמַל (H2830) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: חַשְׁמַל (chashmal) / H2830 is traced through Ezekiel 1:4, Ezekiel 1:27, Ezekiel 8:2 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

structuredEvidence.definition: probably bronze or polished spectrum metal

firstOccurrence.englishText: I looked, and behold,‡ “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. a stormy wind came out of the north: a great cloud, with flashing lightning, and a brightness around it, and out of the middle of it as it were glowing metal, out of the middle of the fire.

timeline.evidenceText: I looked, and behold,‡ “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. a stormy wind came out of the north: a great cloud, with flashing lightning, and a brightness around it, and out of the middle of it as it were glowing metal, out of the middle of the fire.

I saw as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it all around, from the appearance of his waist and upward; and from the appearance of his waist and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness around him.

Then I saw, and behold, a likeness as the appearance of fire; from the appearance of his waist and downward, fire; and from his waist and upward, as the appearance of brightness, as it were glowing metal.

definitions.full: H2830. chashmal חַשְׁמַל noun [masculine] etymology and exact meaning dubious; evidently some shining substance; AV amber; supposed by Thes (q. v.) and most to be a brilliant amalgam of gold and silver, ᵐ5 ἤλεκτρον (see Liddell & Scott under the word 2 ), ᵑ9 electrum ; see also Dl in Baer Ezech. xii ; only in the combination ח ׳כְּעֵין like the appearance of ׳ח Ezek 1:4 , 27 ; הַחַשְׁמַ֑לָה בְּעֵין 8:2 (on ending הָ֯ see Ges § 90 , 2 R a; Co strike out)
